methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch, accessed 2026-06-14. Telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on every plan — non-telephony vertical. Pinecone: all four pricing points (Builder $20, Standard $50 min, Enterprise $500 min, HIPAA add-on $190) confirmed via two separate fetches of pinecone.io/pricing. Weaviate: four-tier structure (Free $0, Flex $45, Plus $280, Premium $400) confirmed on two fetches of weaviate.io/pricing; HIPAA confirmed as 'Enterprise Cloud on AWS'. Qdrant Cloud: pricing page at qdrant.tech/pricing renders JS-only — no USD amounts are published on the public page; the site directs users to a JS calculator at cloud.qdrant.io/calculator which also did not yield amounts; Free tier resource specs (0.5 vCPU / 1GB RAM / 4GB Disk) confirmed; paid tiers marked null per methodology. MongoDB Atlas Vector Search: dedicated search node hourly rates ($0.12–$3.26/hr) confirmed from mongodb.com/pricing; Vector Search runs on dedicated S20–S80 search nodes separate from standard cluster tiers; M0 Free and Flex cluster pricing also confirmed. Chroma: Starter ($0 + usage), Team ($250/mo + usage), Enterprise (custom) confirmed from trychroma.com/pricing; usage unit rates ($2.50/GiB write, $0.33/GiB/mo storage, $0.0075/TiB query) confirmed. Redis Cloud: Free ($0), Essentials (from $5/mo at $0.007/hr), Pro (from $200/mo at $0.014/hr) confirmed from redis.io/pricing; vector search is included in Redis Search feature, no separate cost. Supabase (pgvector): Free ($0), Pro ($25/mo), Team ($599/mo), Enterprise (custom) confirmed from supabase.com/pricing; pgvector/vector search is a built-in Postgres extension included at no extra cost. Zilliz Cloud: pricing page at zilliz.com/pricing is fully JS-rendered and returned only a page title on all fetch attempts; no USD amounts could be verified from the official page or any accessible documentation URL; excluded to avoid fabrication. Benchmark estimate source (benchmark.vectorview.ai/vectordbs.html) used as corroboration reference for realistic workload costs where noted.

vendors.name: Pinecone
vendors.provenance: https://www.pinecone.io/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. Pricing confirmed via two independent fetches. Builder $20/mo flat confirmed. Standard $50/mo min confirmed. Enterprise $500/mo min confirmed. HIPAA add-on $190/mo on Standard confirmed; HIPAA included on Enterprise.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 2 GB storage, 2M write units/mo, 1M read units/mo. Assistant: 500K input tokens, 300K output tokens, 500K context tokens, 1K ingestion units/mo. Inference: 5M embedding tokens, 500 reranking requests/mo. AWS us-east-1 only. No HIPAA.

plans.name: Builder
plans.notes: 10 GB storage, 5M write units/mo, 2M read units/mo. Assistant: 2M input tokens, 1M output tokens, 2M context tokens, 10K ingestion units. Inference: 10M embedding tokens, 1K reranking requests. SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001. AWS only (multi-cloud 'coming soon'). No HIPAA.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $50/mo minimum; pay-as-you-go beyond minimum. Storage $0.33/GB/mo. Write units $4–$4.50/M, read units $16–$18/M. HIPAA available as $190/mo add-on. Backup/restore included. AWS, Azure, GCP all regions.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $500/mo minimum; pay-as-you-go with tiered rates beyond minimum. HIPAA compliance included (no add-on fee). Premium support included. Unlimited storage and usage with tiered pricing. AWS, Azure, GCP.

plans.name: Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC)
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Deploy Pinecone in your own cloud account. Contact sales.

vendors.name: Weaviate
vendors.provenance: https://weaviate.io/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. Four tiers confirmed via two independent fetches. HIPAA confirmed: 'Available on Enterprise Cloud (AWS) for regulated healthcare workloads.' Embedding model pricing (Snowflake Arctic-Embed-M-V1.5: $0.025/1M tokens, etc.) also confirmed.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 100,000 objects, 1 GB memory, 10 GB disk. 2,000 embedding requests/day. 1,000 Query Agent requests/mo. 1 collection, up to 3 tenants. Best-effort SLA.

plans.name: Flex
plans.notes: Starts at $45/mo. Pay-as-you-go beyond minimum. Unlimited objects and collections (up to 1,000). Vector dimensions from $0.00465/1M, storage from $0.12/GiB. 7-day backup retention. 99.5% uptime SLA. No commitment required.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Starts at $280/mo. Prepaid contract with predictable spend. Vector dimensions from $0.003875/1M, storage from $0.10/GiB. 30-day backup retention. 99.9% uptime SLA. SSO/SAML support. Query Agent $30/org/mo (4,000 requests included).

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Starts at $400/mo. Prepaid contract. Shared or dedicated deployment. Dedicated: vector dimensions from $0.002718/1M, storage from $0.1505/GiB. 45-day backup retention. 99.95% uptime SLA. Phone and Slack support. HIPAA available on Enterprise Cloud (AWS).

vendors.name: Qdrant Cloud
vendors.provenance: https://qdrant.tech/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. Pricing page is JS-rendered; the public page displays tier names and feature lists but NO published USD unit rates — the site directs all pricing to a JS-only calculator at cloud.qdrant.io/calculator (also inaccessible). Free tier resource specs confirmed: 0.5 vCPU / 1GB RAM / 4GB Disk, free forever. HIPAA badge confirmed in page footer. Standard and Premium paid tiers are usage-based (billed per vCPU, GB RAM, GB storage) but no rates are publicly disclosed without using the interactive calculator.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Single node cluster. 0.5 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 4 GB disk. Free cloud inference with selected models. Free forever.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Usage-based pricing billed per vCPU, GB RAM, and GB storage consumed hourly. Highly available setups, backup and disaster recovery, free tokens for paid inference models, 99.5% uptime SLA. No published USD rates on pricing page — use cloud.qdrant.io/calculator for estimates.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Minimum spend required (amount not published). Adds SSO authentication, private VPC links, 99.9% uptime SLA, enhanced support. Contact sales for pricing.

plans.name: Hybrid Cloud / Private Cloud
plans.notes: Deploy Qdrant in your own infrastructure. Custom enterprise pricing. Contact sales.

vendors.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
vendors.provenance: https://www.mongodb.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. Vector Search is a feature of Atlas — it runs on dedicated Search Nodes (S20–S80 tiers) separate from database nodes, or on standard Atlas clusters. Search node hourly rates confirmed: High CPU S20 at $0.12/hr (~$87.60/mo), up to High CPU S80 at $3.26/hr (~$2,379.80/mo). M0 Free cluster ($0) supports Vector Search. Vector Search is not separately priced — it is included with cluster cost. HIPAA not mentioned on pricing page.

plans.name: M0 Free
plans.notes: 512 MB storage, shared RAM/vCPU. Vector Search included. 100 ops/sec max. Free forever.

plans.name: Flex
plans.notes: From ~$8/mo, usage-based up to ~$30/mo. 5 GB storage, shared resources, 0–500 ops/sec. Vector Search included. Hourly billing.

plans.name: Dedicated M10
plans.notes: ~$58.40/mo (hourly billing). 10–128 GB storage, 2 GB RAM, 2 vCPUs. Vector Search included on cluster. Dedicated Search Nodes add separate cost: High CPU S20 at $0.12/hr (~$87.60/mo per node, minimum 2 nodes recommended).

plans.name: Search Node S20 (High CPU)
plans.notes: $0.12/hr × 730 hrs ≈ $87.60/mo per node. 4 GB RAM, 106 GB storage, 2 vCPUs. Dedicated Vector Search node, minimum 2 nodes for HA. Add-on to existing Atlas cluster.

plans.name: Search Node S40 (High CPU)
plans.notes: $0.48/hr × 730 hrs ≈ $350.40/mo per node. 16 GB RAM, 426 GB storage, 8 vCPUs. Dedicated Search Node for Vector Search.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom enterprise pricing for large-scale deployments. Includes dedicated support, SLAs, custom data residency. Contact MongoDB sales.

vendors.name: Chroma
vendors.provenance: https://www.trychroma.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. Three plans confirmed: Starter ($0 + usage, $5 free credits), Team ($250/mo + usage, $100 monthly credits), Enterprise (custom). Usage unit rates confirmed: Write $2.50/GiB, Storage $0.33/GiB/mo, Query $0.0075/TiB, Network $0.09/GiB returned. HIPAA not mentioned. SOC II mentioned on Team plan.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $0 base + usage charges. $5 in initial free credits. 10 databases, 10 team members, community Slack. Usage: Write $2.50/GiB, Storage $0.33/GiB/mo, Query $0.0075/TiB queried, Network $0.09/GiB returned.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $250/mo base + usage charges. $100/mo in included usage credits. 100 databases, 30 team members, Slack support, SOC II compliance, volume-based discounts. Same usage unit rates as Starter.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Unlimited databases, unlimited team members, dedicated support, single-tenant clusters, BYOC clusters, custom SLAs. Contact sales.

vendors.name: Redis Cloud
vendors.provenance: https://redis.io/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. Three-tier structure confirmed: Free ($0), Essentials (from $5/mo at $0.007/hr), Pro (from $200/mo at $0.014/hr). Vector search is included in Redis Search feature at no extra cost across all paid plans. HIPAA not mentioned on pricing page. Integration tools listed: Redis Insight, RIOT, client libraries (Python, Node, Java, Go, .NET), SDKs.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 30 MB capacity. Shared cloud deployment. Single database. Best-effort SLA. Community support only. Redis Search (vector search) included.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: From $5/mo ($0.007/hr). 250 MB–100 GB RAM & SSD. Single database. Shared deployment. SAML SSO, RBAC, encryption in transit and at rest. Up to 99.99% uptime. Redis Flex at 10% RAM for lowest cost. Vector search included.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: From $200/mo ($0.014/hr). Unlimited RAM. Multiple databases. Dedicated cloud deployment. Active-Active multi-region. Auto-tiering. Private connectivity. Up to 99.999% uptime. Redis Flex for TBs of data. Vector search included.

vendors.name: Supabase (pgvector)
vendors.provenance: https://supabase.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. Four tiers confirmed: Free ($0), Pro ($25/mo), Team ($599/mo), Enterprise (custom). pgvector is a built-in Postgres extension — no separate cost. HIPAA confirmed as paid add-on for Team and Enterprise plans. Compute is billed hourly; Pro and Team include $10/mo in compute credits.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 50,000 MAUs, 500 MB database, 5 GB egress, 1 GB file storage. pgvector/vector search included as Postgres extension. Community support. Project pauses after 1 week inactivity. Max 2 active projects.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $25/mo base + compute ($10/mo credit included). 100,000 MAUs ($0.00325/additional MAU). 8 GB disk ($0.125/GB overage). 250 GB egress ($0.09/GB overage). 100 GB storage ($0.0213/GB overage). Email support. 7-day backups and log retention. pgvector included.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $599/mo base + compute ($10/mo credit included). SOC2 and ISO 27001 compliance. Project-scoped access. Priority support with SLAs. 14-day backups. 28-day log retention. HIPAA available as paid add-on. pgvector included.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Designated support manager, uptime SLAs, Bring Your Own Cloud, 24x7x365 support, private Slack channel. HIPAA available. pgvector included.
